[James A. Ward](https://www.jamesaward.com/),
[Gillian P. McHugo](https://gillianmchugo.github.io/),
Michael J. Dover,
Thomas J. Hall,
[Said Ismael Ng'ang'a](https://www.qmul.ac.uk/sbbs/staff/saidismaelnganga.html),
Tad S. Sonstegard,
[Daniel G. Bradley](https://www.tcd.ie/Genetics/molpopgen/dan.php),
Laurent A.F. Frantz,
[Michael Salter-Townshend](../index.qmd), and
[David E. MacHugh](https://people.ucd.ie/david.machugh) have published a paper in [*iScience*](https://www.cell.com/iscience):

**[Genome-wide local ancestry and evidence for mitonuclear coadaptation in African hybrid cattle populations (*Bos taurus/indicus*)](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isci.2022.104672)**

Applying local ancestry inference across admixed African cattle breeds, we find significantly elevated taurine nuclear ancestry at genes whose protein products interact directly with mitochondrially encoded proteins—providing genome-wide functional evidence for mitonuclear coadaptation in hybrid mammals.
